title: You Are the Christ
reflectionText: The others answered with the names of prophets — John, Elijah, Jeremiah. Then the question turned and came near: not who do men say, but who do you say that I am? What is it to be asked that to your face, and to find the answer already on your lips, given and not earned?
editorialNotes: Wave 1a (Full-Canon Production Gate CG04). Per Option A (owner-approved), faithfully expanded to clear the 300-word short floor with observable narrative grounding drawn only from Matthew 16:13-20 (the walk into the region, the disciples' gathered/reported answers, the pause created by the personal question, the company continuing after the command of silence) — no invented weather, private thoughts, expressions, scenery, or theology: WEB short 311w / KJV short 315w. Boundary hard-stopped at v20 (no 16:21-23 'Get behind me, Satan'). Peter Gospel-arc hinge: sits after 1124 (water) and before a future Denial and the existing Restoration 1130 — framing only, no arc/journey JSON created.
